user.title: Resel FXO gateway
user.description: Connect to the audio_tcp port of the ESP32 gateway. The ESPHome device itself is added by the normal ESPHome integration; this one only carries the voice.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ESP32.
data_description.port: TCP port of the audio_tcp component.
data_description.token: Same value as audio_token in the ESPHome YAML. Leave empty if none is set.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the ESP32 audio port.
